mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_NO AS commentNo , C.COMMENT_STATUS AS commentStatus , C.COMMENT_CONTENT AS commentContent , C.CREATED_DATE AS createdDate , C.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate , C.DIARY_NO AS diaryNo , C.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , D.DIARY_TITLE AS diaryTitle FROM TB_COMMENT C JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON (C.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_DIARY D ON (C.DIARY_NO = D.DIARY_NO) ORDER BY C.COMMENT_NO DESC
